title: A COVENANT
FOR YOUR LINEAGE
end: The Family Altar — cover your home in prayer
stock_queries: warm lamp lit bible on wooden table
peaceful countryside cottage window at dusk
gentle morning light over family dining table
soft focus greenery near a home entrance
open bible with olive branches on table
tranquil sunset view from a quiet home

scenes.a: If the silence in your home feels heavy with worry for your children’s future, stay.
As for me, this is my covenant with them, saith the LORD;
My spirit that is upon thee, and my words which I have put in thy mouth,
shall not depart out of thy mouth, nor out of the mouth of thy seed,
nor out of the mouth of thy seed’s seed, saith the LORD, from henceforth and for ever.
Lord, anchor our household in this truth, ensuring our legacy remains anchored in Your grace.
